title: The Secret Lives of College Freshmen
description: A college freshman moves into the perfect dorm on campus, but soon discovers the previous resident died under mysterious circumstances. Believing the girl was murdered, she tries to uncover the identity of the killer before it's too late.

title: Secret Life of a Sorority Girl
description: Single mother Cheryl is determined to find her missing daughter Ashley, who was working as a pole dancer at a nightclub to pay for college. Cheryl gets a job at the club to search for clues.

title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
description: A 19-year-old college student meets a successful event planner who offers her a seemingly perfect job to pay for tuition. However, she soon discovers the opportunity is nothing more than a front for a dangerous scheme that caused her friend's death.

title: The Body in the Locker
description: Amy gets the shock of her life when she discovers her late father's storage locker contains the body of a woman. As the truth starts to emerge, she learns that the killer is still out there and she could be the next victim.

title: Soccer Mom Madam
description: A single mother establishes a high-end escort service that matches beautiful young women with the wealthiest and most powerful men in the city. She manages to keep her lifestyle hidden from her kids and others until the FBI starts to investigate her.

title: Who Is Killing the Cheerleaders?
description: A former cheerleader becomes a teacher at the high school where she was nearly killed in a series of brutal slayings. When the attacks start up again, she must find the murderer before they get to her first.

title: Acceptance
description: A woman (Joan Cusack) tries to help her teenage daughter (Mae Whitman) with the college-admissions process.

title: Deadly Match
description: Trina goes live with her unique dating website, and it becomes a huge success until she shuts it down to stop a prostitution hub. When one of the users from the site turns up dead, Trina looks to her now-defunct site for clues to solve the crime.

title: Dying to Be Loved
description: Jill's daughter takes up with a bad boy whose violent behavior lands the young couple in trouble. To avoid a stint in prison, they appear to commit a double suicide, but Jill sets out to prove they have gone on the run.

title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E03 — Husbands Gone Wrong
